title: Cursor iOS app cannot see or reply to local agents for an Enterprise organization
symptoms: Computer does not show remote control access in the Cursor iOS app
Local agents list is unavailable for Enterprise org members
cause: Remote Control is on by default for everyone except Enterprise organizations. For Enterprise it stays off until an admin turns it on.
fix: Have an Enterprise admin enable Remote Control in org settings, then sign in to the iOS app and approve the pairing request in the desktop app.
apply: Org settings > Security and identity > Remote control
affected: Enterprise organizations, from the Oct 6, 2026 Remote Control release
